text:
sophie: Hey @eng-runtime — quick ask for tomorrow's webinar demo. We need a lightweight mini-sweep to back the live numbers. Can the runtime team run a small set (see below) and share artifacts + a one-paragraph methodology we can paste into the deck? :pray:

sophie: Requirements: model=redwood-open-7b, variants=
  - float32 baseline
  - fp16
  - 4-bit quant (q4_0)
payloads: 30 representative prompts (mix of short/medium/long), seed=42, ctx=2048
warmup: 5 warmup requests per variant
runs: 3 reps per payload per variant
metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, coldstart heatmap, tail errors
artifacts: raw traces, sample inputs, run_manifest.csv (columns: run_id, variant, seed, nodes, batch_size, timestamp, notes), and one PNG heatmap
priority: high for marketing — webinar at 09:00 PT tomorrow. We only need a quick, reproducible sweep (not exhaustive). If capacity is tight, do the float32 and q4_0 first and report back.

sophie: Example run command you can adapt:
```
./run_bench --model redwood-open-7b --variant q4_0 --seed 42 --ctx 2048 --warmup 5 --reps 3 --payloads ./webinar_30.json --out ./artifacts/q4_0_run.tar.gz
```

nate: Got it. Two clarifying q's: 1) Which routing profile should we use (prod, canary, or isolated-dedicated)? 2) Do you want autoscaling on for bursts or fixed nodes?

sophie: Use isolated-dedicated for repeatability (no noisy neighbors). Set autoscaling off — fixed 2 GPU nodes. If we absolutely need to trim, we can drop to 1 node but call it out in the manifest.

gabriel: I'll curate the 30 prompts — short/med/long split = 10/15/5. I'll push webinar_30.json to the shared bucket now and add an index mapping for the slides. :thumbsup:

gabriel: folder: gs://redwood-marketing/webinar-artifacts/6112223334/prompts/webinar_30.json

elaine_m: Marketing asks: please include provenance details in run_manifest.csv (who triggered, git commit for benchmark harness, runtime image tag). We also need a small README.md with the methodology paragraph (1-3 sentences) and the exact command used. Can you also include a single sample chat output for the longest prompt so we can screenshot?

nate: Fine. We'll record the harness commit and runtime image. Timeline: kick sweep in ~30m, should finish ~2h (depends on queue). If something blocks, I'll ping here.

runtime_bot: ci-bot: queued job #9921 for artifacts-> gs://redwood-marketing/webinar-artifacts/6112223334 (ETA 30-150m)

nate: Quick note — quantized q4_0 may show minor quality diffs on the long prompt. We'll include a short note in the README about any observed regressions (if >2% change on our internal similarity metric).

sophie: Perfect. If the heatmap shows any >500ms coldstart tails we may switch demo to float32 fallback — please flag immediately.

nate: Will do. tagging: @gabriel for prompts, @elaine_m for marketing artifacts checklist.

sophie: Thanks all — please drop the artifact tar + run_manifest.csv and README link here when ready. :raised_hands:
